node.title: Re: unpack and words (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I would like to split at 30 or the nearest word boundary

Nearest word boundary before or after the 30 characters? [id://1154672].

Update: To answer your question "is it possible to stop unpack splitting words?" - No, [doc://unpack] isn't meant for that. Probably a regular expression would be best, but as I said above, please be more specific as to what your input and expected output is.
